properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.3 ships SHA-1/SHA-2 family implementations in the build's node_modules. No direct workspace dependency declares it; it rides in transitively with the Ethereum JS crypto stack. Changeable here by bumping/overriding the resolution.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: md5@2.3.0 is installed and available to the build. Collision-broken hash — any first-party use for integrity/security purposes would be a CWE-328 finding; no direct call site found in workspace source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: node-forge@0.10.0 ships RSA keygen/encrypt, X.509/PKI, TLS and AES in the yarn.lock build graph; it is what the build installs, whether or not the application itself calls it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Credential-governance artifact: an encrypted (not plaintext) CI credential, its confidentiality delegated to Google Cloud KMS; observable here, replaceable only by the vendor (The Graph) or by re-hosting CI.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: tweetnacl's Ed25519 signature scheme ships in the build; no application call site found. Quantum-deadline risk class, not harvestable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is the Ethereum transaction-signing algorithm — mandated by the protocol, so every deploy script and signer in this Hardhat workspace uses it via the ethereumjs/ethers stack. Quantum-unsafe (Shor), deadline-risk migration class (ECDSA P-256 → ML-DSA-65 analog).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: elliptic's ECDH ships in the build; for this codebase's actual key agreement use, the live surface is the Ethereum secp256k1 tooling rather than standalone ECDH.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: tweetnacl's X25519 key agreement ships in the build; no application call site found. Harvestable risk class (retroactive).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live crypto use in CREATE2 address derivation; algorithm pinned by the Ethereum protocol — changeable only by the chain, not by this repo. Hash class: only Grover-relevant, not harvestable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: node-forge's AES (incl. its TLS stack) ships in the build; no application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: PBKDF2 (via pbkdf2@3.1.2) is quantum-safe as a KDF; its parameter choice (iterations) is what matters. Note the repo separately derives wallet seeds with BIP39 PBKDF2 at 2048 iterations in first-party code (accounts.ts).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes ships audited modern hash implementations. Quantum-safe class (Grover-only); CNSA 2.0 prefers 384-bit digests but this is not an urgent posture item.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.1.2 ships BLAKE3 among its primitives. Grover-only exposure, no first-party call site found. Changeable here by bumping the resolution.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: scrypt (memory-hard password KDF) ships in the build for Ethereum keystore files; no application call site in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-3/shake via @noble/hashes@1.1.2. Note the workspace's dominant SHA-3-family use is Keccak-256 (pre-standard padding) via ethers/ethereumjs in first-party code — a separate object already in the inventory at accounts.ts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: tweetnacl's authenticated encryption ships in the build; no application call site found. Symmetric, not quantum-urgent, but part of the shipped crypto surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: node-forge's X.509/PKI capability ships in the build; no application call site found. PKI infrastructure availability is itself inventory-relevant.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto dependency inventory: this entry plus its ALG-* algorithm children (Ed25519 ALG-683d5cd2, X25519 ALG-defedad1, XSalsa20-Poly1305 ALG-f58a8f00) together describe the tweetnacl surface in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@2.0.4 (exact pin, alongside a newer 3.0.1 resolution) — the keystore-KDF member of the Ethereum JS wallet stack (V3 keystore encryption is scrypt-based). Memory-hard, quantum-safe as a KDF.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: sha.js@2.4.11 provides streaming SHA-1/SHA-2 (224/256/384/512); it is the hash workhorse of the create-hash/crypto-browserify-style stack that Ethereum JS libraries rely on. No first-party direct call.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: md5@2.3.0 ships the collision-broken MD5 hash. Any use of it for integrity/signatures would be a CWE-328 finding; no direct call site found in workspace source — it is available to anything that imports it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: elliptic implements secp256k1/secp256r1 ECDSA signing and ECDH. This workspace transacts on Ethereum, where secp256k1 ECDSA is protocol-mandated — the classic elliptic copy (6.5.2, plus 6.5.4) rides in with the Ethereum JS stack. Same asset family as ALG-710f61f0 (ECDSA via elliptic@6.5.2).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.1.2 — modern audited hash library (SHA-2/SHA-3/BLAKE3/RIPEMD-160 etc.). The build ships it via the Ethereum tooling chain; no direct workspace import found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.3 (exact-pinned alongside a 1.1.7 resolution) provides SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 implementations. The exact pin is the classic elliptic 6.5.2 dependency requirement. No direct workspace import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: pbkdf2@3.1.2 — the Node/browser PBKDF2 polyfill used by the Ethereum JS stack (BIP39 seed derivation, keystore stretching). Quantum-safe KDF; iteration counts at call sites decide its strength.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto dependency inventory: this entry plus its ALG-* algorithm children (RSA ALG-589856a1, AES ALG-0eb2c0da, X.509 ALG-1847d707) together describe the node-forge surface in the build.
